# FAMILY01 B — successor-visible case facts

Calibrated setup; ordinary mineral-soil surface with reflectance 0.15; toward-sun bearing at 21° off nadir; valid stable paired D readings 2.5/2.4 °C. Required M0 inputs are valid.

response.rationale: Both valid D readings exceed 2.0 °C and differ by only 0.1 °C, selecting confirmation under M0. OBS-05 supports retaining this ordinary-surface pathway, but its VWC and plant-water observations cannot be assigned to this case.
response.scope: Ordinary mineral-soil thermal triage; independent VWC and plant-water evidence govern subsequent review.
